It is my pleasure to introduce myself as one of the members of Team-EV-Turkey. In our last assignment of EMU430 Data Analytics, we analyzed the EV market of Turkey with a special emphasis on the infrastructure readiness by 2027.

### Project Summary

The focus of our research is on the question of whether Turkey’s charging station infrastructure will be able to cope with the explosive rise in electric vehicle numbers. Some main points of our research are presented below:

-   **Custom Data Pipeline:** Creation of "City Repair Engine," based on Fuzzy Matching to guarantee 100% data accuracy obtained from EPDK databases.

-   **High Correlation:** Our findings have shown a correlation coefficient of 0.9826 between electric vehicle numbers and charging station numbers, showing the reactivity rather than proactiveness of current investments.

-   **Forecast 2027:** Identification of a great investment deficiency based on Log-Linear models in transit-route provinces.

### Key Takeaways

-   **Exponential Growth:** Turkey is adopting electric vehicles exponentially, surpassing the predictions of conventional linear models.

-   **Infrastructure Shortage:** By 2027, several provinces will be at risk of having an insufficient number of charging points based on present investment trends.

-   **Priority Focus:** The heat map projections show Manisa, İzmir, and Gaziantep as priority provinces for infrastructure development.
